summary: The alert dialog backdrop is confined to the conversation panel instead of covering the full viewport, leaving the side drawer un-dimmed beneath the dialog.

issues.title: Backdrop overlay improperly scoped
issues.description: The dialog overlay dims only the left pane rather than covering the entire viewport.
issues.evidence: The dark scrim stops at the edge of the chat container while the dialog overlaps the drawer.
issues.suggestion: Position the dialog backdrop with fixed inset-0 over the entire viewport.
